# m9m Documentation

> The n8n alternative without the bugs — faster, more reliable workflow automation.

m9m is an open-source workflow automation platform written in Go. It runs n8n workflow JSON unchanged, executes 5–10× faster, uses 70% less memory, and ships as a single 30 MB binary with zero runtime dependencies.

This file follows the proposed llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org/) — a curated, low-cost index of the documentation for AI assistants. For the full concatenated markdown of every page, see https://docs.neullabs.com/m9m/llms-full.txt.

## Start here

- [Home](https://docs.neullabs.com/m9m/): tagline, quickstart, navigation hub
- [Why m9m?](https://docs.neullabs.com/m9m/why-m9m/): full comparison vs n8n with benchmarks and reliability evidence
- [FAQ](https://docs.neullabs.com/m9m/faq/): authoritative Q&A on performance, reliability, compatibility, deployment, licensing
- [Migrate from n8n](https://docs.neullabs.com/m9m/migrate-from-n8n/): step-by-step migration with one-command workflow import

## Nodes (40+ built-in)

- [Nodes overview](https://docs.neullabs.com/m9m/nodes/): complete catalog
- [Core](https://docs.neullabs.com/m9m/nodes/core/): start, noOp, wait, executeWorkflow
- [Transform](https://docs.neullabs.com/m9m/nodes/transform/): set, filter, code, function, merge, json, if, loop
- [HTTP](https://docs.neullabs.com/m9m/nodes/http/): HTTP Request node
- [Triggers](https://docs.neullabs.com/m9m/nodes/triggers/): webhook, errorTrigger, cron
- [Database](https://docs.neullabs.com/m9m/nodes/database/): PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch
- [Messaging](https://docs.neullabs.com/m9m/nodes/messaging/): Slack, Discord, Twilio, Teams
- [AI & LLM](https://docs.neullabs.com/m9m/nodes/ai/): OpenAI, Anthropic
- [CLI Execution](https://docs.neullabs.com/m9m/nodes/cli/): sandboxed Claude Code, Codex, Aider
- [Cloud Storage](https://docs.neullabs.com/m9m/nodes/cloud/): AWS S3, GCS, Azure Blob
- [Version Control](https://docs.neullabs.com/m9m/nodes/vcs/): GitHub, GitLab
- [Email](https://docs.neullabs.com/m9m/nodes/email/): SMTP, SendGrid
- [File Operations](https://docs.neullabs.com/m9m/nodes/file/)
